latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — launch of the automation-workflows skill for solopreneurs.

- Provides a step-by-step playbook to identify, design, and implement no-code automation workflows.
- Covers tool selection with a comparison of Zapier, Make (Integromat), and n8n.
- Includes workflow mapping templates, testing checklists, and troubleshooting tips.
- Offers guidance on monitoring, maintaining, and documenting automations.
- Features advanced workflow examples for client onboarding and content distribution.
